title: Injective Helix 2026: when two IDs became one
summary: Binary-options markets on Injective bound an insurance fund by hashing identity fields end to end. Without separators, two different field tuples collided, a phantom deficit was settled with dust, and about $4.8M left the system. We rebuild the encoding mistake.

case.name: Injective Helix binary options / insurance fund ID collision
case.impact: ~$4.8M across hundreds of short-lived markets (same BlockSec weekly window as Aquifer)
